title: An Unset Table | The next lead

police.speaker: Detective Morris
police.text: We will verify the catering delivery note and keep its source intact. A lead is not a rescue; we cannot assume Victor stayed there.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: I will check the technical trail behind the catering delivery note. Amara, tell me what the records cannot explain.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: I am following the catering delivery note without police backup. Amara has my location; I am not going to turn this into a contest with Victor.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The food was diverted to a caretaker's flat that Victor borrowed.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: The flat has just been cleared. A caretaker kept a duplicate key receipt.

choices.label: Coordinate the next lead with the police
choices.impact: Bring Morris into the next investigation and preserve the evidence behind the catering delivery note.
choices.response: Morris takes the lead into the formal investigation. David checks the record while Amara explains its personal significance.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Decode the next connection with Amara
choices.impact: David checks the technical trail from the catering delivery note; Amara tests it against her own history.
choices.response: David saves the original record and checks its connections. Amara refuses to let Victor's version replace what she remembers.
choices.speaker: David

choices.label: Follow the next trail without police backup
choices.impact: David follows the physical lead from the catering delivery note, keeping Amara informed.
choices.response: David sends Amara his location before moving. Finding Ethan matters more than claiming the search as his own achievement.
choices.speaker: David

metadata.evidence_summary: The food was diverted to a caretaker's flat that Victor borrowed. The flat has just been cleared. A caretaker kept a duplicate key receipt.
